items.quote: @SenKevinCramer & I will soon introduce the GOLDEN DOME Act to reinforce this historic vision of a layered, integrated missile defense system protecting the homeland.
items.promise: Said he and Sen. Kevin Cramer would introduce the GOLDEN DOME Act on layered missile defense.

items.quote: The PRO Vets Act has passed the House! My legislation passed the Senate earlier this month and will now go to the President to be signed into law.

The Senate is about to vote on my bill with Senator Johnson, the Shutdown Fairness Act, to pay our federal workers—air traffic controllers, TSA, military, law enforcement—who are required to work during the Schumer shutdown.
The @SenateCommerce Committee passed my Bycatch Reduction Act, with overwhelming support. It’s the most comprehensive bycatch bill ever introduced in the Congress.

Obamacare, the so-called Affordable Care Act, has not made health care more affordable. The law crashed Alaska’s health insurance market, dropping us from four insurers before Obamacare was enacted down to only one, eventually leaving us now with just two insurers.
Shameful: Senate Democrats just voted against and successfully blocked a bill to pay our troops and fund our national defense.

Huntsville was named the top choice for SPACECOM’s permanent home by the first Trump admin AND the Biden admin.

I will keep fighting to bring @US_SpaceCom home to the Rocket City.
items.promise: Said he will keep working to locate U.S. Space Command's headquarters in Huntsville, Alabama.

items.quote:
It is shameful that Democrats refuse to stand up for women and women’s sports.

This is far from over, and I will NEVER stop fighting to permanently restore Title IX protections.
items.promise: Said he will continue seeking to permanently restore Title IX protections regarding women's sports.

items.quote:
ZERO taxpayer dollars should be used to pay for abortions.

Every life is sacred, and I will always fight for the unborn and the taxpayers.

Glad my bill with @SenTedCruz has passed the Senate and is on to the House.

I will ALWAYS stand up and fight for Alabama’s shrimpers and fishermen.

The bird flu outbreak has devastated our broiler chicken producers across Alabama.

I’m proud to help introduce the Healthy Poultry Assistance and Indemnification Act, which will provide relief to our producers affected by the avian flu.

Back in March, I was proud to bring the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act to the floor to codify President Trump’s Executive Order, PERMANENTLY protecting Title IX.

To no one’s surprise, all 45 Democrats voted to block it.

President Trump is right. Criminals have terrorized DC for too long. Next month, I will introduce a bill requiring teenagers be charged in criminal court. It’s time for all criminals to face consequences for their actions.
items.promise: Said he would introduce a bill the following month requiring teenagers to be charged in criminal court.

items.quote:
Unlike liberal activists judges, President Trump was elected to secure our border and deport those who shouldn’t be here. 

Next week I will introduce legislation to end birthright citizenship for illegal immigrants once and for all.
items.promise: Said he would introduce legislation the next week to end birthright citizenship for children of illegal immigrants.

items.quote:
With permanent Daylight Savings Time, for three months out of the year, kids in West Arkansas towns like Bentonville, Fayetteville, and Fort Smith would start school in the dark.

I will always oppose any effort to adopt Daylight Savings Time year-round.
items.promise: Said he will oppose any effort to adopt year-round Daylight Saving Time.

items.quote: I believe Mr. Kennedy will faithfully implement President Trump’s pro-life, free-market, common-sense agenda and I will therefore support his nomination. I look forward to working with him once confirmed.

Today, @HouseForeignGOP unanimously passed my bipartisan Chip Security Act. I’m thankful for Chairman Mast’s leadership in bringing this important bill to a vote.

My Chip Security Act will keep our most advanced technology from being smuggled to adversaries like Communist China.

As part of the Working Families Tax Cut, Arkansas will receive major funding to support health care in our rural communities.  

I was proud to vote for this bill and support @SarahHuckabee’s request to secure funding.

Thankful for @JohnBoozman's leadership on this year’s Farm Bill, which will provide Arkansas farmers with much-needed support.

I look forward to supporting this bill on the Senate floor.
We should be making it easier for Americans to vote, not harder. If the SAVE Act ever comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO.
items.promise: Said he will vote no on the SAVE Act if it comes to the Senate floor.

items.quote:
Donald Trump knows the Senate can’t pass a bill to fund the government without 7 Democratic votes. So why is he refusing to negotiate?

I will not be one of those 7 unless we address skyrocketing costs caused by health care cuts and tariffs.
items.promise: Said he would not vote for a government funding bill unless it addressed health care costs and tariffs.

items.quote:
This country needs a serious conversation on immigration.

But none of our amendments to the Laken Riley Act were given a vote. They were real solutions to our broken system and would’ve addressed big concerns we had with the bill.

So I voted no.
Despite President Trump’s efforts, our bipartisan ROAD to Housing Act just became law!

Building data centers isn’t the responsibility of communities. Funding them isn’t either. 

If Big Tech wants data centers, they foot the bill for them.

Four years ago marks one of the darkest days in American history. I will vote to certify the election of Donald Trump today because our democracy depends on our commitment to the peaceful transfer of power. Our public servants must respect the results of free and fair elections.

Today, I will be voting against Tulsi Gabbard’s nomination for Director of National Intelligence. America faces very real and growing security threats daily, and we can’t trust that Gabbard will stand up to them.

President Trump’s Department of Homeland Security has made Americans less secure. DHS needs a foundational shift, and I am unsure if Senator Mullin—or any Trump-appointed nominee—is capable of carrying it out. I will oppose his nomination.

Elon Musk and Trump are already shutting down the government. I want to open it back up.

That's why I'm a NO on the Republican spending bill that we'll vote on this week

Today the Senate is voting on a fake stock trading ban that’s a just a Trojan Horse for Trump’s anti-democracy voter suppression bill. All this vote proves is that Republicans aren’t serious about rooting out corruption. They just want an election season fig-leaf.
 
I’m a no.

Health care shouldn't be a luxury reserved for the fortunate few. Medicaid is a vital lifeline that makes our communities healthier while ultimately reducing costs for everyone, which is why I will always fight to protect this essential program.
items.promise: Said he will continue to work to protect Medicaid.
